surface: A grid with no rows: the column headers, the empty data message a Tab reaches after them, and the way out of the grid.

steps.note: With no rows, Tab moves along the column headers, from `In stock` to the last one, `Qty`.

Tab after the last header reaches the empty data message, `No data available. There's nothing to display yet.` Finding: NVDA with Firefox reads only `section`, and VoiceOver with WebKit reads the title and not the description (`No data available and 1 more item`).
Tab leaves the grid for the button after it.
Shift+Tab comes back to the message. Finding: NVDA with Firefox reads only `section`, as on the way in.
Shift+Tab goes back to the last column header.
The arrow keys move along the headers; there is no row to move down to.
